$comment: Conformance vectors of the namespaced reference grammar {{cfg:key}} / {{lvr:key}} (REQ-KVD-11F906, SPEC DOC-KVD-E49C6E F1). Shared byte-for-byte by core, the dashboard tokenizer and kvendra-cli (copy + sha256 under tests/fixtures/). For each text: the distinct unescaped keys of each namespace, in order of first appearance. Key grammar [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}; one backslash right before the braces escapes; no nesting.

refs.name: escape: an escaped reference is a mention, never a reference
escape: double backslash still escapes (the backslash right before the braces)
escape: per reference, the neighbour is not affected
key limit: 128 chars is valid
key limit: 129 chars is not a reference
uppercase: key or namespace with uppercase is not a reference
invalid keys: empty, leading dot/dash/underscore, spaces, placeholder
valid key charset: digits, dot, dash, underscore after the first char
other namespaces and single braces are not references
nesting: only the inner reference is recognised (same namespace)
nesting: across namespaces only the inner one counts
extra braces around a reference
adjacency lvr+cfg
adjacency cfg+lvr with escape on one side
same key in both namespaces is independent
order of first appearance, deduplicated per namespace
unicode text around a valid reference
unicode inside the key is not a reference
fullwidth braces and colon are not references
zero-width characters break the reference
lookalike backslash (fullwidth reverse solidus) does not escape
code spans are not special
no references at all
refs.text: plain text, {{ and }} and lvr: alone
